summary: Rectitude Holdings filed a 6-K on October 12, 2026, disclosing its Singapore subsidiary's share purchase agreement to acquire all shares of MR.BUTLER PTE. LTD. from its sellers. Consideration comprises 800,000 new Class A ordinary shares at an agreed US$1.00 per share, an aggregate US$800,000, with a contractual holdback and a one-year lock-up. Separately, on October 17, 2026, Rectitude agreed two business migration deals, issuing 500,000 shares each to G L Hardware Marketing and INOS for customer relationships and IP. Completion is subject to conditions, notably by November 30, 2026. Watch for holdback mechanics, lock-up overhang, and condition satisfaction.
